root_cause.text: The `file_thp_enabled()` function in the mm/THP subsystem incorrectly grants THP eligibility to anonymous inodes because it interprets their zero `i_writecount` as indicating a read-only regular file without explicitly filtering out anonymous pseudo-file inodes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (IS_ANON_FILE(inode)) return false;` to `mm/huge_memory.c`, directly addressing the CVE description which explains that anonymous inodes created via `alloc_file_pseudo()` have `inode->i_writecount` at 0, causing them to satisfy `!inode_is_open_for_write()` and `S_ISREG()` checks despite being ineligible for THP.
